name: Inventory
description: Persistent item catalog and basic quantities, in an isolated module service and database.

actions.label: Approve supply relationship
actions.confirmation: Approve this explicit source entity, Worker and programme for private supplies until the recorded expiry?

actions.label: Revoke supply relationship
actions.confirmation: Revoke new access to this private supply relationship? Existing reservations remain recorded and require reconciliation.

referenceLeaseSeconds.description: Maximum lease for read-only reference metadata. A lease grants no stock, supplier purchase, or operational authority.

workflowReplenishmentEnabled.description: Route NEW shortage episodes into reviewed workflows instead of the legacy Procurement outbox. Existing pending requests keep their original route. Requires an approved event workflow; enabling this flag alone does not replenish stock.

mcpTools.name: get_inventory_summary
mcpTools.description: Read inventory items and quantity information from this Worker inventory service.
